issues.description: Footer renders twice — once inside <main> (div wrapper) and once as <footer> (contentinfo). Duplicate nav links, contact info, copyright visible on page.
issues.fix: Footer component renders <footer> inside <main>. The component is correct — the issue is likely a layout.tsx also rendering Footer, or an SSR/hydration duplication.

issues.description: Hydration mismatch error in console: 'A tree hydrated but some attributes of the server rendered HTML didn't match'. Causes React to re-render client-side.
issues.fix: Check for Date-dependent rendering (getGreeting, timeAgo) or dynamic geo coord parsing that differs between server and client.

issues.description: favicon.ico returns 404. Browser tab shows generic icon.
issues.fix: Add a branded favicon and apple-touch-icon to public/

issues.description: 48 interactive elements with height < 44px on desktop. Nav links at 16px height. Most are desktop-appropriate but nav touch targets are small.
issues.fix: Add padding to nav links for larger click targets (py-2 minimum)

issues.description: 1 image without alt text (hero background). Decorative images should have alt='' and aria-hidden.
issues.fix: Already has alt='' — this is correct for decorative. The check may be flagging the Next.js Image optimization wrapper.

issues.description: Login redirects to /admin (old CMS) not /dashboard. After logging in at /admin, user must manually navigate to /dashboard.
issues.fix: After login, redirect to /dashboard instead of /admin for client users

issues.description: Page view count increments on every dev server reload. Will inflate in development. No bot/crawler filtering.
issues.fix: Consider filtering by user-agent or adding a flag to skip tracking in development

verdict: Core flows work end-to-end. No blockers. Two majors: duplicate footer and hydration mismatch. Both fixable in minutes. Dashboard flows are clean — all pages load, nav works, mobile responsive, real data displayed.
